method: Seven whole pinned files read; TOML configs parsed, IO test method names inventoried with AST. No actual dataset integration or full upstream test execution.
findings: IO tests use unittest Mock specs for Config/AlgorithmConfig/LocalInput/Output/Dataset. They exercise argument forwarding, indexing lambda, invalid returned type, column-removal flags and cluster pickle content. This is not actual dataset serialization roundtrip.

No reviewed test injects loader OSError or save_to_disk failure after clusters.pickle write; prior progress-state leak/partial-output controls cover omitted failure paths. No LocalHFDataset branch test seen in this file.
Pathlib-path test actually assigns temporary directory string, so its name does not establish Path-valued config support. Pickle-protocol comment only checks loaded content, not protocol bytes.

MinHash,SimHash andBloom example configs all set skip_filtering true and retain annotations/clusters; successful example execution alone would not prove record-removal behavior. Suffix example lacks skip_filtering override.
Default config.toml selects suffix_array with clean_cache true and fixed external repo/cache/output paths. No default runner execution performed.
Bloom example saves clusters although reviewed main passes empty mapping; retained duplicate marker, rather than actual grouping, is the information-bearing output.
gitignore excludes generated output,data,caches and environments. Ignored artifacts do not supply execution evidence or change algorithm semantics.
